d: One of cricket's biggest cheating scandals is back in the spotlight. Eight years after 'Sandpapergate' rocked Australian cricket, former batter Usman Khawaja has made explosive claims in his autobiography, alleging that the entire team knew about the plan to tamper with the ball. Current captain Pat Cummins has strongly rejected the allegation. Former captain David Warner, however, has backed Khawaja and accused Cummins of throwing him under the bus.
